title: TB-Net: A Tailored, Self-Attention Deep Convolutional Neural Network Design For Detection of Tuberculosis Cases From Chest X-Ray Images
summary: TB-Net detects tuberculosis cases from chest X-rays using a tailored self-attention network.
ai_technology: TB-Net, a self-attention CNN, detects tuberculosis in chest radiographs.

evidence.tested: TB-Net was evaluated on chest radiographs for tuberculosis detection; reported sensitivity and specificity are from the selected study cohorts.
evidence.unknown: Dataset composition and selected-case review limit claims of real-world deployment.
evidence.ai_role: TB-Net, a self-attention CNN, detects tuberculosis in chest radiographs.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
